name: The Life You Can Save
summary: Promotes effective giving and raises money for a list of recommended charities fighting extreme poverty.

spending.source: https://www.thelifeyoucansave.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/2025-Public-Disclosure-990-for-TLYCS.pdf (The Life You Can Save, Form 990 for 2025: total expenses $12,201,580 less grants $10,015,067 passed on to charities = own costs $2,186,513); https://www.thelifeyoucansave.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/the-life-you-can-save-financials-2025-.pdf-FInal.pdf (The Life You Can Save Australia, 2025 operating expenses A$653,207, about $421,152 at the IRS's 2025 average of $0.644745 per Australian dollar). Both entities' own costs: about $2,607,665. The grants passed on (US $10.0M, A$13.4M) are donors' money, the recipients' cost.

lines.label: Raising funds for effective charities: recommendations, outreach and the US and Australian giving channels
lines.source: https://www.thelifeyoucansave.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/2025-Public-Disclosure-990-for-TLYCS.pdf (Form 990 for 2025, Part III: one programme, 'Raising funds for effective charities'; its annual report counts both entities' operating costs against the money they move)
